title: Console Strata: Workspace Rail Mapper & Contextual Navigation
creator: Avery Chen
description: Redesign the Console's primary left rail and workspace switcher to support contextual, role-aware navigation and first-class cost/rollout lenses. Deliver a prototype that demonstrates: 1) a condensed 'rail mapper' that prioritizes active routes and surfaces cost indicators inline; 2) workspace switching with quick transient previews (no full route change) and persistent recent workspace history; 3) routing semantics that allow feature rollouts to change visible routes per user segment without reshaping underlying IA. The goal is to reduce cognitive load for engineers and platform teams while exposing cost and rollout state at glance.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive Figma prototype with 3 states: compact, expanded, and transient-preview
Usability test (n=8) with developers showing >85% task success for switching workspace + finding rollout status
Design tokens and specs for left-rail in CSS/Token table ready for handoff
Accessibility checklist passed for keyboard navigation and screen reader hints
Product & Eng alignment confirmed on routing semantics and metrics emitted
design_notes: Introduce a 'rail mapper' glyph to indicate route density and cost heatmap per section—uses color + microbadge counts
Workspace switcher should support ephemeral preview: hover or long-press opens a lightweight snapshot overlay (last 3 dashboards, active rollouts) without routing the console
Cost lens: token-level cost delta should be surfaced as a per-route micro-metric. Needs mapping contract with backend telemetry team
Rollout-aware routing: routes can be feature-flagged and should appear with a subtle 'canary' badge; fallback strategy when route hidden should be documented
Prefer progressive enhancement: collapsed rail keeps primary nav icons; expansion reveals labels and cost micro-metrics

decisions: Adopt density-first rail variant that prioritizes active routes + cost microbadges over full label visibility in collapsed state
Use ephemeral 'preview overlay' for workspace switcher instead of immediately routing the entire console
Expose cost delta per route (7-day rolling) as the primary cost signal in the rail; detailed cost breakdown remains in the Cost dashboard
Rollout badges will be binary (canary / stable) with hover tooltip showing percent rollout; engineering to supply rolloutStatus metric
tradeoffs: Compact rail reduces discoverability of seldom-used routes — mitigated via command palette and improved search
Preview overlay requires additional telemetry to determine if preview action led to a full route switch; adds complexity to event model
Showing cost micro-metrics in rail increases noise for small teams; choose thresholding to only show when cost delta > X%

Hand off design tokens and expanded CSS spec to frontend (PR + token table) — link in attachments
